messages:
emma (Finance): Heads up: Horizon Analytics flagged invoice INV-4337 — they say a partner rebate (5% partner-rate) wasn't applied to their reseller lines. Can billing verify?
raj-csm: Customer escalated to sales ops, wants an explanation and a corrected invoice. They say the partner contract should have auto-rebated reseller charges.
oliver-billing: Checking invoice lines and rebate mappings now. Pulling invoice export.
sophia-eng: I recall a change in reseller tagging last month that might've affected partner lookup for rebates. Will check mapping service logs.
oliver-billing: Billing export ready: /secure/exports/INV-4337-lines.csv. Initial numbers: reseller lines = $42,000, expected rebate = $2,100. No rebate appeared.
sophia-eng: Logs show partner_lookup returned null for allocation_id starting 2026-04-01 due to a schema change: partner_id field renamed to partner_ref. Migration was partially applied.
emma (Finance): So this is a mapping bug during a migration window — similar to past incidents. Proposal: issue a corrective invoice/credit for $2,100 and add a $300 goodwill credit for inconvenience.
raj-csm: Customer also reported they received automated dunning emails before we fixed this. Can we waive late-fee interest for the affected invoice?
oliver-billing: Late fees for INV-4337 = $75. We can reverse late fees as part of the credit memo. Revised total credit = $2,475.
emma (Finance): Approve manual credit $2,475. Please include note referencing partner-rebate-mapping bug MR-612. Need credit memo and accounting entries.
audit-bot: Created audit ticket AUD-2997 for migration-lapse; attached billing CSV.
oliver-billing: Credit memo CM-814 created for $2,475. Journal JE-2026-04-INV4337 posted. Routing to Accounting.
sophia-eng: Adding postmortem action items: complete partner field migration, add integration test for rebate lookup, and run a sweep for invoices generated 2026-04-01..2026-04-07.
emma (Finance): Can we notify partner ops and the customer with a clear explanation? Raj please handle communication; cc finance.
raj-csm: Will draft: "We discovered a migration issue that prevented partner rebates from applying on invoice INV-4337. We've issued a credit of $2,475 (rebate + waived late fees + goodwill) and corrected the system. We're sorry for the confusion." Sending after final review.
emma (Finance): Thanks team, closing FIN-1158 once customer confirms receipt.
